note: A fixture of category X counts as detected when the validator reports at least one error or warning whose code is listed for X. A valid fixture passes when the validator reports no error and no warning (info notes do not count). 'primary' is the code that names the mechanism; 'codes' also lists related codes that diagnose the same failure from another side.

a.name: Astral character (emoji) before the span: UTF-16 vs code point offsets

e.name: Span edge between a letter and its haraka or shadda

g.name: Bidi or zero-width control at a span edge

h.name: Clitic boundary under the include or exclude policy

i.name: Span edge inside a word or token

k.name: Nested spans under the forbid or allow policy

m.name: Invalid tag or tag transition (IOB2, BIOES, BILUO)

q.name: Arabic punctuation at a span edge

v.name: Valid records that must produce no error or warning
